verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at developer.ironcladapp.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, titled 'Ironclad CLM API Documentation'). Docs pages are also served as raw markdown (.md) with a pointer to a complete documentation index, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-oriented guidance, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (all probed paths 404), and no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.
